description: BSC pool autopsy in one call: pool age, liquidity, 1h/24h volume and transaction spike ratios, buy/sell pressure, holder concentration, LP lock, honeypot/tax/mint/ownership flags, and a 0-100 risk verdict with grade. Built from DexScreener, GoPlus and honeypot.is. Accepts a BSC pool/pair address (token addresses resolve to the largest BSC pair). Descriptive on-chain data only — not financial advice. Paid per call via x402: $0.02 USDC on Base — the payment challenge is returned automatically; x402-capable clients retry with payment.

pool.description: BSC pool/pair address (0x + 40 hex); token addresses resolve to the largest BSC pair

window_hours.description: Observation window in hours (1, 6 or 24 map to DexScreener windows; >24 uses 24h) (default: 24)

name: bsc_pool_autopsy
